label: The box K node excludes the subtraction contingency premise at its world (inference)
rule: Box elimination at the world witnessing possible absence
meaning: If the box K necessary-being node holds at w (some actual concrete root n, God with the classical attributes, exists at every world accessible from w), then not every concrete object existing at w is absent at some accessible world: n exists at w and would be absent at an accessible world where it exists. A checked incompatibility between the node and subtraction premise A2 at the node's world. With excluded middle, A2 at w is exactly the denial of the stage-one node STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-AT (controls), so the theist route rejects A2 for the necessary being and no other subtraction premise (theist model).
